hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-outfit tracking-tight font-medium text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-outfit tracking-tight font-medium text-slate-900
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-manrope uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for main containers to ensure breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use a 12-column bento grid for the workspace. Form Builder Sidebar: col-span-1 md:col-span-4. Live Preview / Review Panel: col-span-1 md:col-span-8. Gap: gap-6.
layout_and_spacing.surface: Tactile Neumorphism / Swiss clean look. Cards should be flat (no heavy shadow), using a sharp 1px border (border border-slate-200) and rounded-xl radius.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align form inputs and labels for optimal scanability. Center-align dropzone content.

components.buttons: Customized Shadcn buttons. rounded-lg, tracking-wide text-sm font-medium. Primary actions use slate-900 (authority), AI actions use indigo-600.
components.inputs: Shadcn input and select components. Flat background (bg-white), subtle border. On focus: ring-2 ring-indigo-500/20 border-indigo-500.
components.badges: Inline confidence pills. text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full. Required for all AI-extracted fields during the review step.
components.draggable_cards: Field cards in the builder should have a drag handle icon (lucide-react 'GripVertical'). Use hover state to slightly darken border (hover:border-slate-300) and apply a subtle shadow (hover:shadow-sm) to indicate interactivity.
components.wizard_stepper: Clean horizontal stepper. Active step: indigo-600 circle. Inactive: slate-200 circle. Font: Outfit.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle translate-y or border darkening. Avoid over-animating static elements.
motion_and_interactions.active: Active/Focus states must be highly visible (accessibility priority).
motion_and_interactions.ai_loading_state: Use Framer Motion to create a 'scanning' beam effect over the document preview, or a shimmering gradient text skeleton for fields being extracted.

image_urls.description: Subtle abstract texture. Can be used as a low-opacity background (10-20%) for the app's main wrapper.
3D Geometric empty state illustration. Use this inside the file Dropzone component.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Outfit and Manrope fonts from Google Fonts and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Build a multi-step wizard (Build -> Upload -> AI Extract -> Review). Manage state at the parent level.
Use 'dnd-kit' or 'react-beautiful-dnd' for the drag-and-drop form builder interface.
Implement the Layout using standard CSS Grid (grid-cols-12). Sidebar takes 4 cols, Preview takes 8 cols.
Customize Shadcn UI to remove default heavy Vercel-like shadows. Implement the 'Swiss High Contrast' style (1px border, stark white backgrounds, no shadow).
Ensure the confidence scores (High, Medium, Low) are visually distinct chips placed next to the input labels in the Review panel.
For the Dropzone, build a large dashed-border container with the empty_state_upload image in the center.

All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, form fields, dropzone, wizard steps) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='add-field-button').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially the slate-500 secondary text, meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_management: All inputs and draggable items must be keyboard accessible and have a visible focus ring.
accessibility.aria_labels: Use aria-labels for drag handles and icon-only buttons (like delete field).
